programs.title: Pompeii: Life in the City with Dan Snow
programs.desc: Dan and Kate Lister discover what everyday life was really like for the people who lived in Pompeii over 2000 years ago and the unusual ways they earnt a crust.

programs.title: James May's Great Explorers
programs.desc: James rewrites stories of the greatest explorers in his inimitable entertaining way, starting with Columbus - and how he merely 'stumbled across' two continents, then took the spoils.

programs.title: Secrets of the Chocolate Factories
programs.desc: Behind the scenes at some of the most famous chocolate factories. We see huge machines blending gallons of liquid chocolate with flavours, and we meet the creative real-life Willy Wonkas.

programs.title: Dogs Behaving (Very) Badly
programs.desc: Graeme Hall tackles a hefty 15-stone Leonberger Rio who refuses to budge (except for the local pub) and Jack Russell Archie's attraction to legs - furniture legs..

programs.title: Rich House, Poor House
programs.desc: Single mum Natalee lives on £60 a week but has big dreams. Can a millionaire cosmetic medicine family make her dream of breaking into the beauty industry come true.
